title: Tabs with the Next.js App Router
description: Tabs whose selection lives in the URL with the Next.js App Router: each Tab renders a Next.js Link that does the navigation, Tabs reads selectedId from usePathname and draws no outer edge with $outerEdge={false}, and a single TabPanel shows the server-rendered page of the route while the layout stays mounted. selectOnMove={false} keeps arrow keys from starting navigations, so Enter or a click follows the focused link. Use it when tabs must survive reloads, shared links, and Back and Forward navigation in a Next.js app.
